pathPrefix.description:
path expression to match files.
For other options, set #pathGlob, #pathRegex, "pathContains".
If provided, files with path beginning with this string are selected.

pathGlob.description:
Optional glob to select files. A glob expression
supports '**' which translates to any level in the folder hierarchy.  The glob is normally case sensitive,
but this can be changed with #pathCaseInSensitive.

pathRegex.description:
Optional regex to filter file paths.
 #pathPrefix, #pathGlob, #pathContains

pathContains.description: Filter based on presence of any specific string in file path.

pathCaseInsensitive.description: Whether the match performed against the file path is case insensitive.

mediaType.description: If provided filter files by content media-type.

package.description: If provided filters files by package name.

category.description: If provided filters files by category.

encodedSubPath.description: If provided filters files by encodedSubPath.

isTest.description: If true only test files will be retrieved.

targetType.description: If provided filters files based on target c3 type name.

order.description: If provided files will be ordered  based on package dependency order or  alphabetic order ascending or descending.

readMetadata.description: If true, read metadata for each file before returning.
